package com.acme.payments.validation;

import java.time.YearMonth;

/**
 * Card number / expiry checks performed before we call the acquirer.
 */
public class CardValidator {

    private final java.time.Clock clock;

    public CardValidator(final java.time.Clock clock) {
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    /** Luhn mod-10 check; spaces and dashes are ignored. */
    public boolean isValidNumber(final String pan) {
        if (pan == null) {
            return false;
        }
        final String digits = pan.replaceAll("[ -]", "");
        if (digits.length() < 12 || digits.length() > 19) {
            return false;
        }
        int sum = 0;
        boolean doubleIt = false;
        for (int i = digits.length() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int d = digits.charAt(i) - '0';
            if (doubleIt) {
                d *= 2;
                if (d > 9) {
                    d -= 9;
                }
            }
            sum += d;
            doubleIt = !doubleIt;
        }
        return sum % 10 == 0;
    }

    public boolean isExpired(final int month, final int year) {
        return YearMonth.of(year, month).isBefore(YearMonth.now(clock));
    }
}
